description: AS 1239 leaked traffic from its provider (AS 4637) to its peer (AS 3356), violating AS relationship constraints. The legitimate origin AS 33588 remains unchanged, confirming this is a route leak rather than a prefix hijack. The abnormal relationship pattern indicates provider-to-peer leakage where AS 1239 allowed its provider AS 4637 to reach its peer AS 3356 through an unauthorized path.
